segments.text: let's show you the difference between
the same engineering test done on two
different versions of Altium designer
the task at hand is achieving a merge
project containing the results of
parallel work by two designers each of
whom was responsible for their own part
of the PCB on the right the engineer is
using the manual copying method in Al
designer 23 to do the task and on the
left the engineer is using the new PCB
Cod design tool available without team
designer 25 utilizing the PCB Cod design
tool took IM near 3 minutes and 38
seconds and only required 13 Mouse
clicks while the process without using
PCB code design took 14 minutes and 47
seconds requiring 320 Mouse clicks and
showing a clear advantage in using Al
team designer 25
